strings.ch.port_hint: 人物没有自己设的头像时，用卡里自带的原作立绘（作者 Yehehua，按需从网络加载）；省流时默认关。只取作者声明的立绘，且不碰卡里受限分类的图；取不到的人显示名字首字（不是故障，可以自己设头像）
strings.ch.port_hint@en: No avatar of your own? Use the card's original portraits (author Yehehua; loaded on demand). Off in data-saver mode. Only portraits the author declares, never the card's restricted categories. If one can't load, an initial shows (not a bug; set your own avatar).
strings.char_more_hint: 人物卡里可展开的一栏：代号、社会身份、身高 / 体重、外界知情、饰物（字段在「变量映射」里指定或关闭）
strings.char_more_hint@en: An expandable section on person cards: codename, public identity, height / weight, publicly known, accessories (pick or turn off the fields in Variable mapping)

strings.estate.slow: 庄园三维模型加载较慢…可以继续等，或先看平面图
strings.estate.slow@en: The 3D manor is loading slowly… keep waiting, or view the floor plan
strings.no_fx_hint: 网络攻击时不再闪烁、撕裂，只显示「数据链路受扰」文字
strings.no_fx_hint@en: During cyberattacks, no flicker or tearing — only the "Data link disrupted" note

strings.s.cvd_hint: 事态、图例、人物头像等换成色盲安全配色，并加形状 / 描边区分；同步给庄园与三维页
